nodes.title: Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD)
nodes.summary: The amount of dissolved oxygen required by aerobic microorganisms to break down organic matter in a given water volume over a specific time and temperature.
nodes.examRelevance: AP Environmental Science Unit 8: Aquatic and Terrestrial Pollution; FE Environmental Exam: Water Resources
nodes.careerRelevance: Water Resource Engineers and Wastewater Treatment Plant Operators use BOD to size aeration basins and evaluate discharge compliance.

nodes.title: Dissolved Oxygen (DO)
nodes.summary: The concentration of free, non-compound oxygen molecules dissolved in water, vital for the respiration of fish, invertebrates, and aerobic microbiota.
nodes.formulaOrMetric: DO_crit = (k_d * L_a / (k_r - k_d)) * (e^(-k_d * t_c) - e^(-k_r * t_c))
nodes.examRelevance: APES Water Quality Index testing; Limnology & Aquatic Ecology exams

nodes.title: Streeter-Phelps Oxygen Sag Model
nodes.summary: Classic mathematical model predicting the oxygen deficit downstream from a point-source organic discharge in a river.
nodes.examRelevance: PE Environmental Engineering Exam: Water Quality Modeling
nodes.careerRelevance: Environmental Engineers calculating Total Maximum Daily Loads (TMDLs)

nodes.title: Cultural Eutrophication
nodes.summary: Anthropogenic nutrient enrichment (nitrogen and phosphorus) leading to algal blooms, hypoxia, and dead zones.
nodes.examRelevance: APES Unit 8; IB Environmental Systems and Societies Topic 4

nodes.title: Clean Water Act (CWA) & NPDES
nodes.summary: Primary US federal law governing water pollution, establishing the National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) permit program.
nodes.examRelevance: APES Environmental Law; PE Civil/Environmental Licensure

nodes.title: Remaining Global Carbon Budget
nodes.summary: The cumulative finite quantity of net anthropogenic CO2 emissions that can still be emitted while limiting global warming to a given temperature threshold (e.g. 1.5°C or 2.0°C).
nodes.examRelevance: APES Global Change Unit 9; College Earth Science & Climatology
nodes.careerRelevance: Climate Risk Analysts, Corporate Sustainability Officers (ESG)

nodes.title: Theory of Island Biogeography
nodes.summary: The MacArthur-Wilson equilibrium model stating that species richness on an island is determined by immigration rate (distance from mainland) and extinction rate (island area).
nodes.examRelevance: APES Unit 2: Biodiversity; GRE Biology Ecology Section
nodes.careerRelevance: Conservation Biologists designing wildlife corridors and protected reserve networks (SLOSS debate).
